questions.cardText:
[Computer Science] What is the interconnected network of physical devices that can collect and share data across a network?
A. The Deep Web
B. Virtual Reality
C. Internet of Things (IoT)
Answer: C.
questions.de: Wie nennt man das vernetzte System physischer Geräte, die Daten sammeln und über ein Netzwerk austauschen?
questions.en: What is the name for the interconnected network of physical devices that collect and share data across a network?

timeline.labelEn: Kevin Ashton coins the term 'Internet of Things'
timeline.labelDe: Kevin Ashton prägt den Begriff „Internet der Dinge“

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What are the rains made of on the “inferno” exoplanet WASP-76b?
A. Iron
B. Molten glass
C. Sulfuric acid
Answer: A. WASP-76b is tidally locked to its star, with one side permanently in the daytime and the other in the nighttime. Temperatures are so extreme on the day side that iron vaporizes, and on the night side, it condenses into iron droplets, creating iron rain, according to one theory.
questions.de: Was regnet es laut einer Theorie auf dem gebunden rotierenden „Höllen“-Exoplaneten WASP-76b, wo das Metall auf der Tagseite verdampft und auf der Nachtseite kondensiert?
questions.en: According to one theory, what does it rain on the tidally locked 'inferno' exoplanet WASP-76b, where the metal vaporises on the day side and condenses on the night side?

timeline.labelEn: ESO astronomers report signs of iron rain on the night side of the exoplanet WASP-76b
timeline.labelDe: ESO-Astronomen berichten von Hinweisen auf Eisenregen auf der Nachtseite des Exoplaneten WASP-76b

questions.notes: A hypothesis from ESPRESSO observations (Ehrenreich et al. 2020); later analysis (Savel et al.) found the data do not indicate significant iron condensation on the night side.
